scope: Curated research snapshot; virtual environments, bulk outputs and caches are excluded.
local_improvements_included: Neural cost shaping uses the actual model-state current ratio instead of a constant zero.
Controller comparisons use paired common-random-number trials.
Study output records simulated duration and blocks mechanical-dynamics claims below 0.2 s.
A current-aware planning barrier and nearest-zero-vector soft-current fallback were added without raising protection thresholds.
Fault causes, latch events, confidence intervals and paired effects versus FOC-SVM are reported explicitly.
Event-trigger feedback decisions are evaluated once per step and checked against actual feedback use.
Deterministic multi-process execution was added and verified against serial output.
Model uncertainty was separated from current risk so current limiting does not create false OOD classification.
A machine-readable long-horizon audit rejects incomplete smoke studies and prevents hardware claims.
The final paired revalidation covers 31 scenarios, 30 trials, eight controllers and 0.2 s per trial.
A non-neural C6 robust finite-control-set controller evaluates deterministic parameter sigma points with CVaR and worst-case costs.
A lazy viability predecessor activates near the planning current boundary and avoids unconditional recovery search.
A deterministic cross-entropy falsifier searches motor, DC-link, scenario and seed space for safety or performance counterexamples.
The C6-RV-PWM exploratory matrix covers 31 scenarios, five paired trials and 0.2 s, while explicitly withholding novelty, publication and hardware claims.
C6-BCR canonicalizes five-dimensional model residuals by stator-flux sector and calibrates one split-conformal score over complete 40-switching-step trajectory blocks.

Two blind 24-split C6-BCR studies preserve 95% marginal block coverage within statistical resolution; their 48-split aggregate reduces median 5D hypervolume by 26.1% versus a raw global conformal box.
The rejected action-vector frame, conditional split failures and 1.75x OOD coverage collapse are retained as negative evidence.
An independent audit recomputes conformal rank, pooled coverage, paired sharpness, seed separation and claim boundaries from raw laboratory output.
activation_policy: Research-only. No SNH-PWM source in this snapshot is imported by live inverter firmware.
